pois.name: Μπούρτζι
pois.intro: The water castle of Bourtzi is a Venetian castle located in the middle of the harbour of Nafplio.

pois.name: Παλαμήδι
pois.intro: Palamidi is a fortress to the east of the Acronauplia in the town of Nafplio in the Peloponnese region of southern Greece. Nestled on the crest of a 216-metre-high hill, the fortress was built by the Venetians during their second occupation of the area.

pois.name: Αρχαία Ασίνη
pois.intro: Asine was an Ancient Greek city on the coast of ancient Argolis on a promontory locally known as Kastraki or Paliokastro near the modern village of Asine and Tolon. The rocky peninsula measuring 330 x 150 m and rising 52 m above sea level had strategic advantages and its natural sheltered harbour played a key role in its development over the centuries.

pois.name: Ακροναυπλία
pois.intro: The Acronauplia is the oldest part of the city of Nafplion in Greece. Until the thirteenth century, it was a town on its own.

pois.name: Οικία Κεραμών
pois.intro: The House of the Tiles is a monumental Early Bronze Age building located at the archaeological site of Lerna in southern Greece. It is notable for several architectural features that were advanced for its time during the Helladic period, notably its roof covered by baked tiles, which gave the building its name.

pois.name: Βυζαντινό Μουσείο Αργολίδας
pois.intro: El Museo Bizantino de Argólida es uno de los museos de Grecia de la región de Argólida. Se encuentra ubicado en un edificio histórico cuyo origen tuvo lugar durante la dominación veneciana, en el centro de la ciudad de Argos.

pois.name: Θολωτός τάφος της Τίρυνθας
pois.intro: Das Tholosgrab von Tiryns ist ein unterirdischer Tholosbau, der während der Späthelladischen Zeit um 1300 v. Chr.

pois.name: Μυκηναϊκό φράγμα της Τίρυνθας
pois.intro: The Kifini Dam, also known as the Tiryns Dam, is a man-made dam constructed during the Mycenaean Period of 1260 B.C.E to divert the Lakissa River in Greece. It is located 900 m north of Agios Adrianos, 2 km east of Nea Tiryntha and 4 km east of the Mycenaean Palace of Tiryns.

pois.name: Αρχαιολογικός Χώρος Άργους
pois.description: These are the organized parts of the archaeological sites within Argos. Sites of excavations can be seen all over the city, without paying any fee, but fenced.
